changeSet.author: claude
changeSet.comment:
Per-user eBay marketplace for the price lookup (plan decision 6.4), default EBAY_DE. Mirrors 012-user-language-german-title.
Stored as the marketplace id rather than an enum column of its own kind: the set of marketplaces belongs to the purchaseoffers context, and accountaccess only keeps the user's choice. Values are validated on the way in by the context that owns them.
Existing rows get EBAY_DE, which is also the configured application default, so nobody's behaviour changes when this ships.
